name: SIFT NFL certified-inputs vs operating-model market-free baseline

data.games: sift-data-vault archives/NFL/inseason_player_team/1999-2026/nflverse/snapshot-20261116 schedules/games.csv; whitelist columns only (game_id, season, game_type, week, gameday, gametime, home_team, away_team, home_score, away_score, result, total, home_rest, away_rest, div_game, roof, location); every market column (spread_line, total_line, moneylines, odds) is never loaded
data.first_half_total: per game, max over plays with qtr <= 2 of total_home_score + total_away_score (vault pbp); games with no qtr<=2 rows dropped
data.kalshi_quotes: nfl-edge-finder market-data branch data/kalshi/backfill (2025 season only)
data.kalshi_settlement: sift-data-vault archives/NFL/kalshi_official_settlements/all-to-20261116 result field (yes/no only; anything else dropped)

seasons.playoffs: reported separately, test seasons only, same frozen models

targets.team_points: team-game rows (two per game): points scored

baseline.name: DATA_ONLY / Milestone-E football-only game centre of nfl-edge-finder (nfl_edge/arms/data_only.py == scripts/research/game_model_study.py)
baseline.why: the repository's own documented market-free game projection (docs/PROSPECTIVE_THREE_ARM_EXPERIMENT.md 'DATA_ONLY, exactly'); the simulation layer (scripts/sim/walkforward.py, baseline_5y.py) takes its game centre from the closing line and research/projection_foundation team_points is the closing implied total, so neither is market-free
baseline.regular_season_features: committed nfl-edge-finder research/game_model/game_features.parquet (point-in-time opponent-adjusted ridge ratings per (season, week), 11 pbp metrics, half-life 10 weeks, season carry 0.4, ridge 4, built from silver 2006+)
baseline.playoff_features: same ratings code (nfl_edge.research.team_ratings.snapshot_ratings) rerun on silver team_game rebuilt from vault pbp 2010+ with nfl_edge.data.silver.team_game_from_pbp; snapshot week = playoff week (REG rows of seasons S-3..S only)
baseline.models: margin: ridge(lambda 30) on d_<11 metrics> + rest_diff + div_game + neutral; total: ridge(lambda 30) on m_h_/m_a_<11 metrics> + indoor + rest_diff; standardised, NaN->0; refit for every target season S on REG games of seasons max(2010,S-8)..S-1 (2012 and 2013 therefore train on 2 and 3 seasons)
baseline.fidelity_check: reproduced model_margin/model_total must match committed research/game_model/walkforward_predictions.parquet (2014-2025) to < 1e-6
baseline.first_half_total: NOT produced by the operating model: baseline_1h = a + b * baseline_total, OLS fitted on fit seasons 2012-2021 (an added transparent mapping, labelled as such)
baseline.caveat: the PROE metric inside the baseline derives from nflfastR xpass, which the repo's own audit calls indirectly market-informed; kept for fidelity

certified_inputs.source: sift-alpha-ops alpha_engine/features/nfl.py compute() on the vault pbp + games.csv (Paths(nfl=WORK/nflcache) with pbp/pbp_<yr>.parquet symlinks); only catalog ids with ledger VERIFIED_* in research/input_research/data_foundation/verified_coverage.json

game_level_construction.total_and_first_half: pair -> (h.X + a.defX) + (a.X + h.defX); single -> h.X + a.X except margin_pre -> |h - a|; rest_gap -> |rest_gap|; short_rest, bye -> h + a counts; outdoors, div_game as is; home not used
game_level_construction.margin: pair -> (h.X + a.defX) - (a.X + h.defX); single -> h.X - a.X; rest_gap (home row); short_rest, bye -> h - a; outdoors, div_game as is; home not used
game_level_construction.team_points: pair -> own.X + opp.defX; single -> own.X and opp.X; rest_gap (own row); short_rest, bye -> own and opp; outdoors, div_game, home as is

certified_inputs.missing_values: filled with the training-set mean of the column

candidates.all: residual stacking: (y - baseline) ~ intercept + baseline + features; baseline projection always a feature
candidates.C3: ridge on standardised C1 + C2 features (+ baseline), alpha from grid logspace(-2, 4, 25) by forward-chaining season CV on fit seasons only (validate s in 2016..2021, train 2012..s-1, pooled MSE)
candidates.selection: per target, the candidate with lowest validation (2022-2023) RMSE when fitted on 2012-2021; it is the PRIMARY test model whether or not it beat the baseline on validation; all three are also reported on test as secondary
candidates.test_fit: selected (and secondary) candidates refitted once on 2012-2023 (fit + validation; ridge alpha kept from fit-season CV) and applied to 2024 and 2025 unchanged
candidates.baseline_on_test: walk-forward per its own design (season S trained on S-8..S-1)

metrics.per_target: RMSE, MAE of baseline and candidates on TEST REG weeks 1-18 pooled and per season
metrics.paired: mean(sq_err_candidate - sq_err_baseline); 95% percentile bootstrap CI clustered by (season, week), 2000 resamples, numpy default_rng(13); team_points rows are team-games within the same week clusters
metrics.playoffs: same metrics on 2024+2025 playoff games, bootstrap clustered by game, labelled small-sample

situations_EXPLORATORY.projected_total_tercile: baseline game total cut at 1/3 and 2/3 quantiles of fit-season (2012-2021) baseline totals
situations_EXPLORATORY.note: selected candidate vs baseline per target; same clustered bootstrap; labels EXPLORATORY, no multiplicity correction

price_aware.condition: only if archived executable two-sided quotes exist

quotes.moneyline_KXNFLGAME: candle files data/kalshi/backfill/candles[_v2]/KXNFLGAME: last candle (h60 or 1-minute arrays) with end_period_ts <= kickoff - 3600 and non-null yes_bid.close and yes_ask.close; kickoff = horizons anchor_ts (anchor_kind kickoff) else schedule gameday+gametime America/New_York
quotes.spread_total_teamtotal_1htotal: horizons/*.jsonl T-90m snapshot (the backfill's last candle at or before kickoff-90m, built from the same candlestick endpoint; the only archived bid/ask source covering every strike); require snap ts <= anchor_ts - 3600, book_empty false, age_min <= 180
quotes.validity: 0 < yes_bid < yes_ask < 1; trades and anything after kickoff never used

price_aware.probability: normal on the selected candidate's projection with sigma = that candidate's validation (2022-2023) residual SD for the target; ML P(home)=P(margin>0); spread YES 'team wins by over k' = P(team margin > k); total, team total, 1H total = P(X > floor_strike)
price_aware.selection_module: copies of sift-alpha-ops alpha_engine/pipeline/selection.py and sift_clv/canonical.py, evaluate(contracts, rules, boot=2000, seed=13)
price_aware.secondary: same evaluation with the baseline's probabilities (diagnostic comparison only)
price_aware.if_no_bid_ask: report prediction vs market mid only; profitability UNTESTED

amendments: recorded in protocol_amendments.json; this file is never edited after its sha256 is written
